The '''Mayagüez metropolitan area''' ([[Spanish language|Spanish]]: ''área metropolitana de Mayagüez''), is the fourth largest [[metropolitan statistical area]] (MSA) in [[Puerto Rico]], comprising the municipalities of [[Mayagüez, Puerto Rico|Mayagüez]], [[Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico|Cabo Rojo]], [[San Germán, Puerto Rico|San Germán]], [[Lajas, Puerto Rico|Lajas]], [[Sabana Grande, Puerto Rico|Sabana Grande]], and [[Hormigueros, Puerto Rico|Hormigueros]] between the [[Coastal plain|coastal plains]] and the [[Cordillera Central (Puerto Rico)|Cordillera Central]] mountain subrange in the southwestern region of the [[Geography of Puerto Rico|main island]]. One of [[Puerto Rico statistical areas#Metropolitan statistical areas|6 metropolitan statistical areas]] in Puerto Rico, it lies within the Mayagüez–[[Aguadilla metropolitan area|Aguadilla]] [[combined statistical area]] (CSA), which is one of [[Puerto Rico statistical areas#Combined and primary statistical areas|3 primary statistical areas]] in the main island as defined by the [[United States Census Bureau]]. As of 2023, census estimates place the population of the Mayagüez metropolitan area at 207,877.<ref name="PopCBSA">{{cite web |date=June 2024 |title=Puerto Rico Municipios Population Totals: 2020-2023 |url=https://www.census.gov/data/tables/time-series/demo/popest/2020s-total-puerto-rico-municipios.html |access-date=August 15, 2024 |publisher=[[United States Census Bureau]], Population Division}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Metropolitan and Micropolitan Statistical Areas in the United States and Puerto Rico, July 2023 |url=https://www2.census.gov/geo/maps/metroarea/us_wall/Jul2023/CBSA_WallMap_Jul2023.pdf |access-date=8 October 2024 |website=United States Census Bureau}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

==Mayagüez metropolitan area ==
With an estimated population of 207,877 as of 2023, the Mayagüez metropolitan area (MSA) is the fourth populous in [[Puerto Rico]], covering 6 of 78 [[Municipalities of Puerto Rico|municipalities]] in the southwestern region of the [[Geography of Puerto Rico|main island]]. Mayagüez is considered to be its [[principal city]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web |date=2023-07-01 |title=Update of Statistical Area Definitions and Guidance on Their Uses (OMB Bulletin 23-01) |url=https://bidenwhitehouse.archives.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/OMB-Bulletin-23-01.pdf |access-date=2024-03-05 |format=[[comma-separated values|CSV]]}}</ref> The Mayagüez metropolitan area is the [[Metropolitan statistical area|223rd most populated]] in the [[United States]] between the [[California-Lexington Park, MD MSA|Lexington Park, MD MSA]] and the [[Chico, CA MSA]].

=== Municipalities ===

* [[Mayagüez, Puerto Rico|'''Mayagüez metropolitan statistical area''']] '''(MSA) (6 municipalities)'''
**  [[Mayagüez, Puerto Rico|Mayagüez]] Pop: 69,798<ref name="PopCBSA2">{{cite web |date=June 2024 |title=Puerto Rico Municipios Population Totals: 2020-2023 |url=https://www.census.gov/data/tables/time-series/demo/popest/2020s-total-puerto-rico-municipios.html |access-date=August 15, 2024 |publisher=[[United States Census Bureau]], Population Division}}</ref>
** [[Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico|Cabo Rojo]] Pop: 46,665
** [[San Germán, Puerto Rico|San Germán]] Pop: 30,996
** [[Lajas, Puerto Rico|Lajas]] Pop: 22,872
** [[Sabana Grande, Puerto Rico|Sabana Grande]] Pop: 22,210
** [[Hormigueros, Puerto Rico|Hormigueros]] Pop: 15,336
The [[San Germán–Cabo Rojo metropolitan area|San Germán–Cabo Rojo metropolitan Metropolitan Statistical Area]] was formerly a separate area in Puerto Rico, but this area was dissolved, and its municipalities were added to the Mayagüez metropolitan area in 2023.<ref>{{cite web |date=1 July 2023 |title=Update of Statistical Area Definitions and Guidance on Their Uses (OMB Bulletin 23-01) |url=https://bidenwhitehouse.archives.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/OMB-Bulletin-23-01.pdf |access-date=24 March 2024 |format=[[comma-separated values|CSV]]}}</ref> 

=== Topography ===
[[File:USA Puerto Rico topographic location map.png|thumb|275x275px|]][[File:Puerto_Rico_geography.gif|thumb|300x300px|General [[Physical geography|physiographic]] map of Puerto Rico, with [[Mountain|mountainous]] terrain in green, [[karst]] in orange, and [[Coastal plain|plains]] in yellow ]]
Comprising Mayagüez, Cabo Rojo, San Germán, Lajas, Sabana Grande, and Hormigueros, the Mayagüez metropolitan area is situated between the western and southern [[coastal plain|coastal plains]], the [[Río Grande de Añasco|Añasco]] Valley, the [[Lajas Valley]], the [[Guanajibo River|Guanajibo]] Valley, and the [[Cordillera Central (Puerto Rico)|Cordillera Central]] mountain subrange in the southwestern region of the [[Geography of Puerto Rico|main island]] of Puerto Rico.

All municipalities have an urbanized, densely populated downtown area and administrative center, categorized as a [[Barrios of Puerto Rico|barrio]] and known as a ''pueblo,'' and concentrated urbanized residential areas with large populations, especially along the coastlines of [[Mayagüez, Puerto Rico|Mayagüez]], [[Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico|Cabo Rojo]], and [[Lajas, Puerto Rico|Lajas]]. All municipales have rural areas, particularly those that lie on mountainous terrain like [[San Germán, Puerto Rico|San Germán]], [[Sabana Grande, Puerto Rico|Sabana Grande]], and [[Hormigueros, Puerto Rico|Hormigueros]].

==Mayagüez–Aguadilla combined area==
The Mayagüez–Aguadilla [[combined statistical area]] (CSA) is divided into two [[metropolitan statistical area]]s (MSA), the Mayagüez MSA and Aguadilla MSA, covering 13 of 78 [[Municipalities of Puerto Rico|municipalities]] in [[Puerto Rico]].

In 2009, the Mayagüez–Aguadilla combined statistical area comprised 6.5% of total population in Puerto Rico. The [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] placed the population at 519,331, a 51.61% increase over the [[United States Census, 2000|2000 census]] figure of 251,260.<ref>{{cite web |date=2010-03-23 |title=Table 4. Annual Estimates of the Population of Combined Statistical Areas in Puerto Rico: April 1, 2000 to July 1, 2009 (CBSA-EST2009-04) |url=https://www.census.gov/popest/metro/tables/2009/CBSA-EST2009-04.csv |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100615175339/http://www.census.gov/popest/metro/tables/2009/CBSA-EST2009-04.csv |archive-date=June 15, 2010 |access-date=2010-03-31 |work=2009 Population Estimates |publisher=[[United States Census Bureau]], Population Division |format=[[comma-separated values|CSV]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=2010-03-23 |title=Table 4. Annual Estimates of the Population of Combined Statistical Areas in Puerto Rico: April 1, 2000 to July 1, 2009 (CBSA-EST2009-04) |url=https://www.census.gov/popest/metro/tables/2009/CBSA-EST2009-04.csv |access-date=2010-03-31 |work=2009 Population Estimates |publisher=[[United States Census Bureau]], Population Division |format=[[comma-separated values|CSV]]}}</ref> The [[2020 United States census|2020 census]] placed the population at 467,599, a 9.96% decrease over the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] figure of 519,331.

With an estimated population of 458,312 as of 2023, the Mayagüez–Aguadilla combined statistical area is the [[Puerto Rico statistical areas#Combined and primary statistical areas|2nd most populous CSA]] in Puerto Rico and the [[Combined statistical area|93rd most populous CSA]] in the [[United States]] between the [[Kalamazoo-Battle Creek-Portage, MI Combined Statistical Area|Kalamazoo–Battle Creek–Portage, MI CSA]] and the [[Cedar Rapids-Iowa City, IA Combined Statistical Area|Cedar Rapids–Iowa City, IA CSA]].
